root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `if (!data) return;` at the start of `trigger_data_free()`. The commit message states: "If trigger_data_alloc() fails and returns NULL, event_hist_trigger_parse() jumps to the out_free error path. ... trigger_data_free() does not. This causes a NULL pointer dereference in trigger_data_free() when evaluating data->cmd_ops->set_filter."
